note: Pre-outcome snapshot. Frozen at entry to prevent hindsight bias. Do not edit after outcome is known.
thesis: AAL is a genuine relative-strength leader (+3.9% vs SPY +1.6%). Based 13.39-13.44 through midday, then broke to a new intraday high 13.50 at 18:00Z on heavy volume (1.74M-share 5min bar vs ~0.5-0.9M prior), and is HOLDING the breakout (13.46-13.50) rather than fading. Matches the profile that has been paying in the paper book this week: the high-volume RS leader that holds new highs, not the thin/marginal name.

invalidation.rationale: Under the whole afternoon base (13.38-13.44). Deliberately set WIDER than the immediate base to respect the P-2026-0010 tight-stop-whipsaw lesson and to satisfy the §9 min risk band ($0.15-0.50). Risk = $0.15/share = ~0.75% of the ~$19.90 account.

risk.sizing_basis: Real equity ~$19.90; whole-share constraint (§9). $20,000 sim basis NOT used for live sizing.

rule_compliance.notes: First REAL trade taken on a defined edge (contrast T-2026-0001 F, which was owner-directed with no setup). Owner also explicitly asked for a real trade today; this one independently meets the setup criteria.

caveats: Late-day entry (~2:26 PM ET, ~1h34 to close) — less runway for the 2:1 target; logging as a data point on late vs midday breakouts.
Single whole-share means spread/fees are a large fraction of the tiny edge; this trade is about proving a real edge + process, not P&L that can fund operations.
